name: ty-gateway-oec-test
kernel_baseline: Linux 6.x ARM64 supplied by the verified OEC base

loader.source: user-provided MiniLoaderAll.bin previously used to flash fnOS on this OEC
loader.status: known-good for the user's fnOS flash only; L1.0 compatibility with a new base is not yet proven

rescue.address_source: cloud-provided, never hardcoded in the image

candidate_base.source: retired; OPHUB wxy-oect base was not hardware-validated on ordinary OEC
candidate_base.reason: A DTB path substitution is insufficient to prove ordinary-OEC boot-chain, partition, kernel and network compatibility
candidate_base.next_base_policy: Use an OEC/OECT community-tested base such as oec-jp.img, verify it unchanged on this device, then add the TY overlay; never rewrite its boot partition
